scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Patrakar Swasth Bima Yojna Niyamawali 2021
other_conditions: Applicant must be an accredited journalist residing and working within Jharkhand
Media representatives must belong to newspapers, magazines, news agencies, electronic media or news‑based electronic media
Applicant must be regularly or contractually employed by the respective media organization
Applicant must possess an accreditation certificate issued by the state government
Freelance journalists must present valid press credentials issued by the Information and Public Relations Department
Insurance coverage includes the journalist’s spouse and up to two unmarried dependent children up to 21 years of age
Applicant must deposit 20 % of the annual premium via cheque/demand draft to the designated account; the remaining 80 % is covered by the Department
Beneficiary nomination and dependent details must be provided in the application form for claim settlement
In case of treatment or accident, the insurer and the Information and Public Relations Department must be informed within seven days
The scheme is valid for one year and requires renewal before expiry
If the journalist leaves the organization or the profession, benefits cease and any contributed premium is forfeited
benefits_summary: Provides health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per year for accredited journalists, covering the journalist, spouse, and up to two dependent children.
documents_required: Accreditation certificate issued by the state government
Valid press credentials (for freelance journalists) issued by the Information and Public Relations Department
Completed application form (Appendices A and B) with necessary attachments
